opening.argument: The presentation promotes a binary plan as lucrative and ties its benefits to recruiting and affiliate activity. The speaker says the plan works through “a binary marketing plan” and that organizing affiliation can produce “a lot of other interesting benefits,” then explains how to distribute an affiliate link by email, Facebook, Skype, or a blog. The structure requires paid packages, including a stated minimum interesting package of 500 euros, while participant packages generate commissions and points. Those points are used on both sides of the organization, with the lower-point amount converted into euros. The presentation also claims that an investment will multiply by 10 percent in a very short time and illustrates weekly earnings of 380 euros through direct and binary bonuses. These are promotional claims rather than verified outcomes.
